description: LBE fluid properties lbh15, published by newcleo Codes and Methods group, implements thermophysical and thermochemical correlations for lead, bismuth and lead-bismuth eutectic. Coverage: The correlations concern lead, bismuth and their eutectic alloy in the OECD/NEA 2015 handbook; validity ranges depend on the individual property correlation. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. The licence is LGPL-3.0. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: A standard implementation of handbook correlations is not independent experimental validation of those properties. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning, resilience studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
